mapper.sql: id, owner_id, workbook_id, workbook_version_id, dataset_version_id, mode, status, sample_size, seed, error_message, claim_token, claimed_by, lease_expires_at, execution_attempt, retry_of_run_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rule_runs ( id, owner_id, workbook_id, workbook_version_id, dataset_version_id, mode, status, sample_size, seed, error_message, retry_of_run_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{ownerId}, #{workbookId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{workbookVersionId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{datasetVersionId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mode}, #{status}, #{sampleSize,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{seed,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{retryOfRunId,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{createdAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, #{startedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rule_runs WHERE (#{mode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR mode = #{mode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND ( (status = 'QUEUED' AND (claim_token IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler})) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at <= #{now,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'QUEUED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rule_runs SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{now,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, error_message = 'FULL run lease expired; outputs were not replayed automatically', claim_token = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE mode = 'FULL' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND claim_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at <= #{now,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}

UPDATE rule_runs SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = #{finishedAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, error_message = NULL, claim_token = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE rule_runs SET claim_token = #{claimToken,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, claimed_by = #{claimedBy}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, execution_attempt = execution_attempt + 1, started_at = CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN NULL ELSE started_at END, status = 'QUEUED', finished_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND execution_attempt = #{expectedAttempt} AND (claim_token IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler})
